steps.step: Prepare an unarchived Contract with an Entity, a Counterparty, a value, a High priority and risk, the Confidential flag, and the other staff role and a Business User on the team
steps.expected: Prerequisite record exists for this role
steps.actual: C-37 "DOC-029r2 contracts-b C18 legal_team_member 1789581116732" created by Nadia Haddad; entity Helix Software Ltd; value GBP 9,900.00 annually; priority High; risk High; Confidential; team adds Daniel Okafor and Ravi Menon.

steps.step: Overview Contract card: choose Term type Fixed term, then pick Effective date and Expiry date and type Notice period (days), saving one change at a time
steps.expected: Fixed term has no renewal-period value; each value saves on its own; the notice deadline is expiry minus the notice period
steps.actual: Four separate PATCH commits answered 200. Renewal period (months) was absent on Fixed term. After reload the pickers read "Feb 1, 2026" and "Jan 31, 2027", notice 30 days; the record's notice deadline is 2027-01-01 (Jan 31, 2027 minus 30 days).

steps.step: Key dates shows the derived Current term expires and Renewal notice deadline rows, and the Term timeline draws the recorded dates
steps.expected: Derived rows reflect the recorded term and carry no row actions
steps.actual: Term timeline: "Term timelineInitial termFeb 1 – Jan 31, 2027Jan 1, 2027Notice deadline Jan 1, 2027TodayFeb 1Jan 31, 2027Initial termNotice deadline". Key dates rows: "Jan 31, 2027Current term expiresDerived" and "Jan 1, 2027Renewal notice deadline — 30 days before expiryDerived", each with 0 row action buttons.

steps.step: Change Term type to Auto-renewing and type Renewal period (months)
steps.expected: Auto-renewing accepts a renewal period in months
steps.actual: Term type Auto-renewing and Renewal period 1 month saved (PATCH 200, 200); expiry still 2027-01-31.

steps.step: Change Term type to Evergreen and review the saved values
steps.expected: Evergreen has no expiry date; changing to Evergreen clears the expiry and the renewal period
steps.actual: Evergreen saved; expiry null, renewal period null; Expiry date picker absent; effective date kept 2026-02-01; Key dates now lists: no derived term rows.

steps.step: Change back to Auto-renewing, record expiry and renewal period, then change to Fixed term and review; finally restore Auto-renewing with a 1-month period
steps.expected: Changing away from Auto-renewing clears the renewal period and keeps the expiry
steps.actual: Auto-renewing -> Fixed term cleared the renewal period (null) and kept expiry 2027-01-31. The Contract is Auto-renewing again: expiry 2027-01-31, renewal 1 month, notice 30 days, notice deadline 2027-01-01.

steps.step: Negative: a Task due date before the notice deadline does not feed the term-derived deadlines
steps.expected: Current term expires and Renewal notice deadline stay derived from the term; the Task does not show as a Key date
steps.actual: A Task due 2026-12-01 was added. Key dates still reads "Jan 31, 2027Current term expiresDerived" and "Jan 1, 2027Renewal notice deadline — 30 days before expiryDerived" and lists no Task row; the record's notice deadline stays 2027-01-01.

steps.step: Approvals: select Renew; Confirm the roll is the default; an entered date on the current expiry is refused; Cancel changes nothing
steps.expected: Invalid new expiry is refused with the dialog's message and Cancel keeps the term
steps.actual: Renew opened "Confirm renewal" with Confirm the roll checked, "The term currently runs to Jan 31, 2027.", proposed New expiry date 2027-02-28, and no Paper as amendment option (no primary Document). Entering 2027-01-31 and selecting Confirm renewal showed "A roll moves the term forward. Pick a date after the current expiry." Cancel left expiry 2027-01-31.

steps.step: Confirm the roll with the proposed date and check the new expiry, notice deadline, Last renewal, the renewal row, and the unchanged Status
steps.expected: The term advances only through the confirmation; Status and Stage do not change
steps.actual: Confirm renewal (POST 200) moved expiry 2027-01-31 -> 2027-02-28; notice deadline 2027-01-29 ("Jan 29, 2027Renewal notice deadline — 30 days before expiryDerived"); Approvals & signing shows 1 renewal row "Term advanced to Feb 28, 2027From Jan 31, 2027NHNadia HaddadSep 16"; Overview "Last renewalSep 16"; Status stays Draft (draft).

steps.step: Stale confirmation: with Renew open, the other staff role changes the expiry; selecting Confirm renewal is refused and the dialog shows the refreshed expiry; Cancel and reopen gives a fresh proposal
steps.expected: A stale roll is refused and re-read; no second roll is recorded
steps.actual: Dialog proposed 2027-03-28; Daniel Okafor moved expiry to 2027-04-30 through the API; Confirm renewal answered 409 with "This contract's expiry has already moved. Read the record again before confirming the roll.". The dialog then said "The term currently runs to Apr 30, 2027." and kept the entered 2027-03-28. Cancel and reopen proposed 2027-05-30. Expiry 2027-04-30; renewal rows still 1.

steps.step: Competing confirmations: both staff roles open Renew on the same expiry; the first Confirm renewal records the roll and the second is refused
steps.expected: Two competing confirmations do not record the same roll twice
steps.actual: Both dialogs proposed 2027-05-30 / 2027-05-30. Nadia Haddad's Confirm renewal answered 200; Daniel Okafor's answered 409 with "This contract's expiry has already moved. Read the record again before confirming the roll.". Expiry 2027-05-30; renewal rows 2 (one per distinct roll).

steps.step: Paper as amendment: after the first Document is uploaded, reload and reopen Renew; File the amendment opens Add version with the Amendment kind; the new version is not executed until marked, and marking replaces the chain's designation
steps.expected: Amendment is a kind, not an executed designation; no new Contract and no expiry change
steps.actual: Before a Document existed the dialog had no Paper as amendment (previous step). Uploaded doc029-services-agreement.pdf as the primary Document and marked it executed; after reload Paper as amendment -> File the amendment moved to /contracts/37/documents and opened Add version with Kind "Amendment". After upload: v1 draft_ours executed=true; v2 amendment executed=false. Mark as executed copy on version 2 gave: v1 draft_ours executed=false; v2 amendment executed=true. Expiry still 2027-05-30; relations {"parentChain":[],"children":[],"links":[]}.

steps.step: Renewal banner: an Auto-renewing Contract whose expiry has passed shows Renewal date passed — pending confirmation with Review renewal, which opens the same dialog
